sloka: त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारं त्रैलोक्योद्वेगदं महत् ।जेतारं लोकपालानां क्षेप्तारं शङ्करस्य च ।। ६.११४.४९ ।।
transliteration: trailokyavasubhoktāraṁ trailokyodvegadaṁ mahat ।jetāraṁ lokapālānāṁ kṣeptāraṁ śaṅkarasya ca ।। 6.114.49 ।।

translations.english: "Ha! Could it be a dream? Is it true? How could you be killed by Rama? You who can kill death also, how did you fall prey to death?"
